text:
tasha_gtm: Opening thread for Skybridge co-sell POC — partner asks: 10-day private tenant trial, a short SSQ response, SSO + SCIM onboarding, and an estimated committed pricing range.

omar_se: Skybridge legal sent an SSQ and requires SSO before sharing data. They prefer GCP IdP (OIDC) and want SCIM provisioning. For pilot they're fine with redwood-managed KMS; prod needs BYOK.

felix_privsec: I'll own the SSQ. Ask them to confirm VPC CIDRs and whether they need SIEM forwarding. For artifacts: we'll provide a redacted SOC2 and a one-page controls matrix. Data deletion SLA: default ephemeral logs 48h; metrics 30d.

maria_ops: Ops can provision a constrained private tenant for 10 calendar days if they sign the pilot addendum and prepay baseline capacity ($2.5k). We'll restrict GPUs and egress; tenant will be single-AZ and not SLA-backed. Need peering choice (VPC peering or Private Service Connect).

kevin_eng: Perf ask: they want 120 rps at 256 tokens with p50 ~0.16s/token. With KV cache and moderate batching that probably needs autoscaled reserved pool. Ballpark reserved price: $40k-$60k/mo depending on region and exact GPU SKU.

tasha_gtm: Can we allow a no-commit short trial just to validate SSO and telemetry? Procurement needs a short window to approve bigger deals.

omar_se: Yes, but we require a signed pilot addendum and prepayment. Also we can demo BYOK onboarding but not enable HSM for trial.

felix_privsec: For SIEM forwarding we support Splunk/Datadog. If Skybridge wants logs forwarded during trial, they must provide HEC endpoint and token. We'll redact sensitive fields.

ssot-bot: Minimal OIDC snippet:
`issuer: https://accounts.skybridge/gcp`
`redirect_uris: [https://console.redwood/pilot/callback]`
SCIM: base /scim/v2 with Bearer token.

maria_ops: Action list: 1) Felix = SSQ responses + SOC2 redacted, 2) Maria = trial tenant provisioning + prepay instr + egress IPs, 3) Kevin = perf sim + sizing doc, 4) Omar/Tasha = collect IdP metadata & schedule enablement.

kevin_eng: I'll post a short perf-runbook tomorrow with expected instance counts, cache warm-up steps, and a cost sensitivity chart for cache hit % vs node count.

tasha_gtm: I'll collect GCP IdP metadata today and ask procurement for the HEC details if they want SIEM forwarding. Scheduling a 30-min enablement next Wed to walk OIDC + SCIM + telemetry.

felix_privsec: One more ask from legal: Skybridge wants a short incident response summary and a pen-test high-level note. I'll attach redacted summaries.

maria_ops: Ops note: trial will be rate-limited and not suitable for full production load. We'll include teardown automation on day 11.

tasha_gtm: Thanks team — I'll post the pilot addendum and calendar invite once Felix posts the SSQ pack. :thumbsup:
